profile: Dine Brands Global owns and franchises IHOP, Applebee’s Neighborhood Grill + Bar and Fuzzy’s Taco Shop restaurant concepts. IHOP and Applebee’s operate in full-service dining categories, while Fuzzy’s is a limited-service fast-casual concept. Most restaurants are operated by independent franchisees. The company earns revenue from franchise royalties and advertising fees, sells proprietary products to franchisees, operates restaurants and receives rental income.
